question: Who was the Portuguese Governor who captured Goa from the Sultan of Bijapur in 1510?
explanation: Afonso de Albuquerque, the second Portuguese Governor in India, captured Goa from Yusuf Adil Shah, the Sultan of Bijapur, in 1510 with the assistance of the local Hindu privateer/admiral Timoja.

question: In which year did Goa become the official capital of the Portuguese State of India (Estado da Índia), replacing Cochin?
explanation: Nuno da Cunha, the Portuguese Governor of India, officially shifted the seat of the Portuguese government from Cochin to Goa in 1530.
